# SealPolicy

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Publish` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public record SealPolicy
```

What a sealed export permits its recipient to do. Written into the seal header in the clear, and bound to the passphrase by [`SealManifest.PolicyMac`](Nfty.Core.Publish.SealManifest.md#p-policymac).

## Constructors

### SealPolicy(bool, bool) { #m-ctor-system-boolean-system-boolean }

```csharp
public SealPolicy(bool AllowExport, bool AllowEdit);
```

**Parameters**

- `AllowExport` (`bool`) - Whether nfty will write the assets back out of the seal. False is the point of the feature.
- `AllowEdit` (`bool`) - Whether nfty will let the contents be modified in place.
